newsitem.title: USA: Virgin expands North American service.
newsitem.headline: Virgin expands North American service.

text.p: Virgin Atlantic Airways said on Monday it will expand North American services for summer 1997 with a number of new flights.
The expansion will include a new daily New York (Newark) to London Gatwick service, starting June 26, 1997, Virgin said.
Virgin said the following changes are also expected to take place as of June 30, 1997:
* A second daily flight will be available from Los Angeles to London Heathrow.
* A daily flight starting from Miami to London Heathrow will replace the current flight between Miami and Gatwick.
* The timing of the Gatwick to Boston flight will change to a more convenient late morning departure from London.
Virgin said it is able to expand services with the purchase of five new aircraft being delivered this year, two Boeing Co 747-400s and three Airbus A340-300s.
The expansion will give Virgin Atlantic 12 daily departures from Heathrow and four from Gatwick, the carrier said.
